GADON TO VP SARA: MAGTAWAG KA NG RALLY SA EDSA, TAWAGIN MO MGA GALIT NA PILIPINO

WATCH: Presidential adviser for poverty alleviation Larry Gadon challenges Vice President Sara Duterte over her claim that Filipinos are angry over the arrest of former president Rodrigo Duterte.

“Umandar na naman ang hallucination ni VP Sara… Asan ang galit? Magtawag ka ng rally sa EDSA, tawagin mo ang mga galit na Pilipino,” Gadon said in a video statement.

The former president is currently detained in The Hague, Netherlands, where he faces crimes against humanity charges before the International Criminal Court. @newswatchplusph
